extracted.intended_audience: Applicants to the Jane Coffin Childs Memorial Fund postdoctoral fellowship
extracted.subtask_description: Instructions and requirements for preparing and submitting an application to the Jane Coffin Childs Memorial Fund postdoctoral fellowship via the Temelio portal, including eligibility limits, proposal formatting, supporting documents, and reference/advisor forms.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submission portal and deadline
rubrics_metrics.description: Applications and letters must be submitted in the TEMELIO portal by January 31, 2025 at 12pm Eastern Standard Time (Noon).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This document is for preview only — applicants must register and apply through the Temelio portal. Automatic reminders are sent for missing documents one week and several days before the deadline. Preview your complete application via PDF Preview and Download before submitting because you cannot make changes after submission.

rubrics_metrics.name: Complete each application field / autosave behavior
rubrics_metrics.description: Please complete each field. Fields will autosave every 10 seconds.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Once fields are complete click 'Next' to proceed. You can come back and make changes before final submission, or log back in at any time to continue work.

rubrics_metrics.name: Applicant personal and contact information
rubrics_metrics.description: Required applicant fields include First Name, Last Name, Middle Initial, Degree conferred or in progress, Email, Phone Number.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide accurate contact and degree information as prompted in the Applicant Information section.

rubrics_metrics.name: Proposed research project and advisor identification
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide Proposed Research Project Title; Name and degree of Proposed Postdoctoral Advisor; Proposed Postdoctoral Advisor University/Institution; whether the Postdoctoral Advisor is an Investigator of the HHMI or a Freeman Hrabowski Scholar; and the advisor's contact information (street, city, state/province, zip, country, email).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Complete the advisor contact fields fully. The advisor will later be required to complete a Postdoctoral Advisor Form in the portal.

rubrics_metrics.name: Project research area choices
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide Proposed Project Research Area: Primary Choice and Project Research Area: Secondary Choice.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Select the most appropriate research area(s) to categorize your proposal.

rubrics_metrics.name: Postdoctoral experience eligibility (18-month limit)
rubrics_metrics.description: An applicant may not have more than 18 months of postdoctoral research experience as of January 31, 2025 (i.e., must not have started postdoctoral research before July 30, 2023).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you are currently a Postdoctoral Fellow in the proposed advisor's lab, you must enter the date you started in that lab. If you exceed the 18-month threshold you are ineligible.

rubrics_metrics.name: Postdoc start/expected start date entry
rubrics_metrics.description: If currently in the proposed postdoctoral advisor's lab, enter date started; if not, enter date you expect to start in the proposed postdoctoral advisor's lab.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide accurate dates to establish eligibility relative to the 18-month limit.

rubrics_metrics.name: Current employment/institution info if not in advisor's lab
rubrics_metrics.description: If not in the proposed advisor's lab, enter current University or organization name and current position title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This documents current affiliation and position for reviewers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Project selection reflection (personal/scientific motivation)
rubrics_metrics.description: Please reflect on how you selected your research project subject and what about the specific project motivates you scientifically and/or personally.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Limit 200 words. Respond in narrative form addressing both scientific and/or personal motivation for the chosen project.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ph.D. conferral date eligibility (24-month limit)
rubrics_metrics.description: Ph.D. degree must not have been conferred more than 24 months prior to the application deadline of January 31, 2025 (i.e., must not have conferred Ph.D. before January 31, 2023).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Enter Date Ph.D. Conferred/Expected. Dual degree M.D.-Ph.D. applicants should contact the program office (jccfund@yale.edu) regarding extended timeline criteria.

rubrics_metrics.name: Thesis research summary content and format
rubrics_metrics.description: Thesis Research Summary should be in narrative form - do not list dates and positions only. Describe your thesis research, including a summary of your research project, its relevance in the field and whether it contributed to your selection of your postdoctoral research project and lab.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Format: Limit 300 words. Font size should be 12 point.

rubrics_metrics.name: Undergraduate study information
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide Name of Undergraduate Institution, Undergraduate Field of Study, and Undergraduate degree.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Supply basic undergraduate education details in the specified fields.

rubrics_metrics.name: Publications inclusion rules and citation requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: List all publications from oldest to newest for which you are an author, including a hyperlink to each article. Only include publications that are in the submitted stage of 'preprint,' 'in press' or 'published.' Do not send manuscripts in preparation to be submitted.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include a note following each publication regarding how this publication was impactful to the field, and what the applicant's contribution was to the publication. Citation Format: Author(s), Publication year, Title, Publication or Journal name, Volume number, Page number range. Include hyperlink to article.

rubrics_metrics.name: Honors and Awards listing
rubrics_metrics.description: List the date received, name and sponsoring entity of each honor and award, from oldest to most recent.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide complete and chronological details for honors and awards.

rubrics_metrics.name: Other research and professional experience listing
rubrics_metrics.description: List the titles of other research, laboratory or training positions you have held, including dates of employment, university/company/other and field of research/profession. List from oldest to most recent.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Be chronological and include enough detail for reviewers to understand prior roles and fields.

rubrics_metrics.name: Postdoctoral training in same institution / direct extension prohibition
rubrics_metrics.description: Postdoctoral training in the same institution in which the applicant received their graduate degree is not preferred, particularly if it is in the same department. Proposals that are direct extensions of graduate work will not be funded.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If proposing training in the same institution or with the same department as graduate work, you must address this below in the application. Explain distinctions from your graduate project and justify why the proposed postdoctoral project is not a direct extension.

rubrics_metrics.name: Abstract for proposed postdoctoral research
rubrics_metrics.description: I. Abstract: Please enter a short abstract of your proposed postdoctoral research project.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Format: Limit 250 words, 12 point font.

rubrics_metrics.name: Proposal statement content expectations
rubrics_metrics.description: The research proposal should describe the background/rationale and proposed work for the applicant's postdoctoral fellowship. The proposal should be developed with the applicant's chosen postdoctoral advisor. Independent ideas and contributions are expected from the applicant.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Objective: State the specific research objectives/aims and method of approach of your fellowship project. Avoid field-specific jargon and acronyms/abbreviations. Please limit your use of abbreviations, as they make it hard for the reviewer to read the proposal. Keep the reader in mind. The proposal must demonstrate a clear rationale for the research, but does not need to include precise and in-depth experimental details.

rubrics_metrics.name: Proposal formatting and file requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: II. Proposal - Upload PDF of Your Proposal Text (2 pages of text; do not embed figures).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Format: Limit two single space pages. Text should be 12 point, Times New Roman. Margins must be greater than or equal to .25 inches. DO NOT EMBED FIGURES OR INCLUDE REFERENCES IN THE STATEMENT; they are included separately below. Save and upload as a PDF.

rubrics_metrics.name: Literature Cited (References) upload and citation format
rubrics_metrics.description: III. Literature Cited (References) to support proposal statement - Upload Literature Cited as a PDF.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Format: Please save and upload the proposal statement literature cited as a PDF. Literature cited should follow this format: Author(s), Publication year, Title, Publication or Journal Name, Volume Number, Page number range.

rubrics_metrics.name: Figures and figure legends file requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: IV. Include a figures PDF - Upload PDF of Figures and/or Figure Legends and Charts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Format: Please save and upload figures as a PDF. 2 pages maximum.

rubrics_metrics.name: Postdoctoral Advisor Form requirement and process
rubrics_metrics.description: Proposed Postdoctoral Advisor Form (To be completed only by advisor): Applicants must have their proposed post-doctoral advisor complete the form to apply.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Click 'Manage Letters and Required Signatures' to start this process. Applicants should alert their proposed advisor that an email from the Jane Coffin Childs Memorial Fund (jccfund@yale.edu) will arrive once the applicant sends the invite. If not received, check spam filters and resend invite if necessary. Step-by-step instructions are available via a provided link.

rubrics_metrics.name: Letters of Reference requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Applicants must submit three (3) letters of reference. The first letter of reference should be directed to the applicant's Ph.D. thesis advisor. None of these letters should come from the proposed postdoctoral advisor.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Click 'Manage Letters and Required Signatures' to initiate invites. Applicants should contact all referees to alert them an email from jccfund@yale.edu will arrive when the applicant clicks 'send' invite; check spam and resend if necessary. Follow step-by-step instructions provided in the portal.

rubrics_metrics.name: Authorized fiscal signature requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: Applicants must obtain an authorized signature from Fiscal sponsor at your proposed University/Institute.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Click 'Manage Letters and Required Signatures' to start. Alert authorized fiscal contacts that an email from jccfund@yale.edu will arrive when the applicant sends the invite; check spam and resend if necessary.

rubrics_metrics.name: Review & submission finality and preview requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: Please review all sections of the application by clicking through 'Back' and 'Next' or by clicking the PDF preview button. Once you submit your application, you will not be able to make any additional changes to the application, nor access the reminder button for your three external referees, post-doctoral advisor form or fiscal officer signature.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: To view your complete application prior to submission, click PDF Preview and Download in the preview window prior to submission. Automatic reminders for outstanding documents will be sent one week and several days before the deadline.
